study type: Secondary analysis of a multicenter randomized trial
cohort: 614 twin pregnancies (570 without GDM and 44 with GDM) from a multicenter randomized trial
finding: After adjusting for maternal age, in vitro fertilization treatment, race, and prepregnancy body mass index, the rate of hypertensive disorders of pregnancy did not differ between twin pregnancies with and without GDM.
mod_finding: The cesarean section rate was higher in the GDM group compared to the non-GDM group, even after adjusting for confounders (aRR = 1.27 [95% CI = 1.06-1.50]).
